resources.name: Kanakku Pulla
resources.description: Local API tests for the Kanakku Pulla AI-agent wallet. Change base_url in the environment if your dev server is not on port 3000.

resources.name: 1 · Compile rules
resources.description: POST /api/compile {text} -> {policy, warnings, mode, store}

resources.name: Compile: demo policy (6 sentences)
resources.description:
The sample rules from the dashboard. Expect 7 rules (the gambling/crypto sentence becomes 2), each keeping its source sentence.

mode is 'gemini' or 'claude' when a key in .env works, otherwise 'fallback'. Every mode returns the same shape.

body.text:
{
  "text": "Never pay more than ₹5,000 in a single payment.
Ask me before anything above ₹1,000.
Keep food under ₹1,500 a day.
Block gambling and crypto.
Ask me before paying new merchants.
Block anything on Zomato."
}

resources.name: Compile: per-payment and daily cap
resources.description:
Expect max_per_txn 2000 and daily_total_cap 10000, both 'block'.

mode is 'gemini' or 'claude' when a key in .env works, otherwise 'fallback'. Every mode returns the same shape.

resources.name: Compile: time window
resources.description:
Expect time_window startHour 23, endHour 6 (restricted hours, IST).

mode is 'gemini' or 'claude' when a key in .env works, otherwise 'fallback'. Every mode returns the same shape.

resources.name: Compile: empty text
resources.description: Never an error: returns an empty policy with a warning, HTTP 200.

resources.name: Compile: malformed JSON body
resources.description: Routes never return 500. A body that is not JSON is treated as empty.

body.text: {not json

resources.name: 2 · Run agent
resources.description: POST /api/agent {task} -> {requests, mode, store}

resources.name: Agent: order dinner
resources.description:
Returns 3-6 PaymentRequests (Indian merchants, UPI ids, INR integers).

mode is 'gemini' or 'claude' when a key in .env works, otherwise 'fallback'. Every mode returns the same shape.

resources.name: Agent: plan a trip
resources.description:
Travel-flavoured requests: trains, flights, hotels, cabs.

mode is 'gemini' or 'claude' when a key in .env works, otherwise 'fallback'. Every mode returns the same shape.

resources.name: Agent: dashboard task
resources.description:
The default task from the dashboard. A mix that usually includes risky payments.

mode is 'gemini' or 'claude' when a key in .env works, otherwise 'fallback'. Every mode returns the same shape.

resources.name: Agent: live web search (slower)
resources.description:
search: true makes Gemini use Google Search (about 6-15s). Expect 3-6 requests and a non-null 'search' object with the queries it ran. If the live search is unavailable (rate limit, timeout), search is null and the AI or the built-in samples answer instead.

mode is 'gemini' or 'claude' when a key in .env works, otherwise 'fallback'. Every mode returns the same shape.

resources.name: Agent: malformed JSON body
resources.description: Falls back to a default task instead of failing.

body.text: {not json

resources.name: 3 · Authorize payment
resources.description: POST /api/authorize {policy, state, request} -> {decision, mode, store}

resources.name: Approve: small payment, known merchant
resources.description: Expect status 'approve'. No AI is involved: the decision comes only from the rules engine.

resources.name: Ask: above ₹1,000 and a new merchant
resources.description: Expect 'ask' with ruleIds [r2, r6]: needs the human's approval.

resources.name: Block: gambling category
resources.description: Expect 'block' with ruleIds [r4]. BLOCK beats ASK: the new-merchant rule also triggers but is not listed.

resources.name: Block: over the per-payment limit
resources.description: Expect 'block' with ruleIds [r1, r3]: over the ₹5,000 limit and over the ₹1,500 food cap.

resources.name: Block: blocked merchant
resources.description: Expect 'block' with ruleIds [r7].

resources.name: Block: daily cap reached
resources.description: ₹4,800 already spent on 2026-10-24 (IST) plus ₹600 goes over the ₹5,000 cap. Expect 'block'.

resources.name: Approve: next day resets the daily cap
resources.description: Same wallet state, but the payment is on the next IST day, so the totals no longer count. Expect 'approve'.

resources.name: Block: night-time window (1:30am IST)
resources.description: 2026-10-24T20:00Z is 01:30 IST on the 25th, inside the restricted 11pm-6am window. Expect 'block'.

resources.name: Fail closed: invalid request
resources.description: A negative amount can't be read, so nothing moves. Expect 'block' (HTTP 200, never 500).

resources.name: Fail closed: missing policy
resources.description: No policy means no permission. Expect 'block'.

resources.name: Fail closed: malformed JSON body
resources.description: Expect 'block', HTTP 200.
